newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazilian steelmakers started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazilian steelmakers started.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said Wednesday it had started coverage of Brazilian steelmakers Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao (CST) and Usiminas with buy ratings.
-- It said it also started coverage of steelmaker Acesita with a sell rating.
-- On CST, HSBC James Capel said, "Prospects for slab prices, unlike those of other flat steel products, are good and should contribute to a significant increase in CST's operating profitability."
-- Acesita is expected "to return a weak operating performance" over the next two years, it said.

-- Usiminas "is the quality steel producer in Brazil, and although earnings growth is limited by capacity until 1999, in the short term we expect outperformance as the shares regain the premium to the sector which they deservedly enjoy."
